record.body:
## Rationale

The stamp must name the producer. `orchestra` matches the CLI that writes the check-run and ends the lie that Affidavit produced it. The user adopted approach A, which specified this marker.

## Counter-argument

A more specific `orchestra-check` (vs suite) would distinguish writers. One marker keeps close-batch matching simple and matches today's single `RUNNER` constant shared by check and suite.
record.subject: runner-marker
